final: WITH counts AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), percentages AS (SELECT BillingState, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) as percentage FROM counts), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM percentages), filtered AS (SELECT BillingState, cnt, percentage, cnt - (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_count) as diff FROM percentages WHERE cnt > (SELECT avg_cnt FROM avg_count)) SELECT SUM(cnt), AVG(percentage), AVG(diff) FROM filtered
